description: This is a CLASSIC attempt at a NO-flip Court.
strategy:
Strategy:

This deck was inspired by a couple of Scott Lingrell’s decks.

Starting Effects:

Imperial Decree (V) vs. Force Choke Decks

Krayt Dragon Bones (V) vs. Profit

Secret Plans vs. Mind What You Have Learned

Ability, Ability, Ability (V) vs. Everything Else

Unusual Card Choices:

Uncertain is the Future – A lot of decks use starting effects to pull cards out of their reserved before the game starts (i.e., Strike Planning).  This card is to, hopefully, place it back into their decks after they have already used their ability.  Also, if you happen to not start with this you can pull it with Unexpected Interruption.  You will have enough Force (5) to pull it off without having to worry about not receiving any from your opponent.

Levitation Attack (V) – This is in here in order to pull Droid Detector and Restraining Bolt from under your starting effect.  This will hopefully be effective versus Profit decks that try to set up A Gift using Threepio and the odd Rescue the Princess to keep Artoo or 8D8 away from the Detention Block Corridor.

Set For Stun – This is here to remove any annoying characters that may come a knocking to the Audience Chamber (notably Leia, Rebel Princess).

Setup:

Use Audience Chamber’s text to pull Jabba and then use Jabba’s Influence to pull either Lyn Me or Rodian (V) to start getting your Bounty Hunters out.

There really isn’t much to playing this deck, just try to keep your opponent off balance and out-drain and out-battle him/her.
